author: nflaig
content: has someone else looked at https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5754, so it seems like since https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5719 a builder can get a canonical payload but not pay if the proposer self slashes in it's own block, doesn't seem like a big deal, but the asymmetry is that the payment still goes to the slashed proposer if the child block arrives 2+ epochs later
